Alex Chen: Quick weekly check — following up on the repeat escalation for Veridian where their requests hit KV-cache OOMs three times in 48h. ticket: DBO-503.
Priya Nair: ugh, saw that. spike correlates with nightly batch + long-context chat at ~03:00 UTC.
Jon Ramos: I pushed a small retry/backoff on the client yesterday, but logs show the runtime still emitted OOMs at the same time window.
Miguel Ortega: Incident trace attached in the ticket — looks like model shard rebalance coincided with cache eviction. probably race between shard health + cache warming.
Sasha (AM): Heads-up — Veridian flagged this as a renewal risk if reliability doesn't improve. They escalated to their CTO this morning.
oncall-bot: Incident DBO-503 reopened by Miguel Ortega (see: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DBO-503)
Alex Chen: Action items I propose: 1) Jon to add exponential retry + jitter in client (low-risk). 2) Miguel to add a short KV cache warmup on deploys for Veridian's dedicated pool. 3) Priya to coordinate a brief runbook review with infra. 4) Sasha to update the customer on plan and record renewal risk note.
Priya Nair: I can own runbook review — can we target EOD Thu (Apr 2)? I'll ping infra and request a 30-min sync.
Jon Ramos: I can get the retry change out today and a canary tomorrow morning. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/7821
Miguel Ortega: Cache warmup feature needs an infra flag but I can prototype a simple staged prefill for Veridian's namespace by Fri.
Sasha (AM): I'll draft the customer message after we confirm owners and ETA. Would like to avoid scaring them but be transparent about steps.
Alex Chen: Ownership matrix: Jon -> client retry PR (owner). Miguel -> cache warmup (owner). Priya -> runbook + infra sync (owner). Sasha -> customer comms + renewal note. Alex -> follow-up on completion and escalate to ops if blockers.
Priya Nair: Adding a small doc note under /kb/clients/veridian-repeat-ooms for future handoffs. Miguel, can you drop a short summary into the ticket when prototype ready?
Miguel Ortega: Will do. I'll include perf numbers and the expected reduction in cold-start OOM probability.
Jon Ramos: Deploying canary at 09:30 UTC tomorrow, will monitor token failure rate and tail latency.
Alex Chen: Ok. Please update the ticket with timestamps and monitoring graph links. If we don't see improvement after the canary, we open a follow-up escalation to eng-plat and schedule a deeper postmortem.
Sasha (AM): Noted. I'll add a renewal-risk flag in our CS tracker and tentatively mark the account as "at risk" until we confirm.
oncall-bot: Monitoring alert rule created: DBO-503-followup (owner: Jon Ramos) — Alert on 5xx token failures > 0.5% over 5m
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Quick check on deadlines: Jon PR today, canary tomorrow 09:30 UTC, Miguel prototype by Fri EOD, Priya runbook sync Thu, Sasha customer comms after canary. If anyone hits a blocker call me out here. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: Copy.
Jon Ramos: On it.
Miguel Ortega: noted.
Sasha (AM): I'll send the customer note draft after the canary run.
Alex Chen: Closing this thread for now — will reopen with status updates in the ticket.
